verdict.rationale: OpenTofu configurations are code you can keep in version control (opentofu-gh-2, opentofu-docs-16). Review is supported through `tofu plan` previews, speculative plans before code review, and saved plan files that can be applied later (opentofu-docs-3, opentofu-docs-4, opentofu-docs-21). Rollback is not evidenced as a native feature; it is only implied by reverting the versioned code and re-applying it with external VCS tooling, so the story is only partly delivered. Missing for 10: native rollback or state-history restore capability, documented rollback workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of the review/rollback loop.
